intro: BIO tags distinguish the beginning and interior of named entity spans. Auditing transitions catches an interior tag that has no compatible predecessor.
task: Report I-type tags lacking an immediately preceding B-type or I-type tag of the same entity type.
requirements: Each tag is O or B-TYPE or I-TYPE, where TYPE is a nonempty ASCII letter sequence. Return indices of I-TYPE tags whose immediately previous raw tag is neither B-TYPE nor I-TYPE of the same type. An invalid I tag still becomes the raw previous tag for the next position.
Sequence inputs are Python lists or tuples of at most 1000 items. Text inputs contain valid Unicode scalar characters and at most 10000 characters.
Return the documented Python output types and preserve all caller inputs. Raise ValueError for invalid inputs unless the task explicitly reports a record-level rejection.

hints.body: Inspect the immediately preceding tag and compare entity types.
